content:
For each prime \(p\mid n\), since \(n\) is squarefree and \(xy\mid n\), the prime \(p\) can occur in exactly one of three states:

- in neither \(x\) nor \(y\): factor \(1\),
- in \(x\) only: contributes \(\varphi(p)=p-1\),
- in \(y\) only: contributes \(p\).

Thus
\[
S=\prod_{p\mid n}\bigl(1+(p-1)+p\bigr)
=\prod_{p\mid n}2p
=2^{10}n.
\]
Therefore
\[
\frac{S}{n}=2^{10}=1024.
\]

\boxed{1024}
